posts.subject: Dream Prop hunt???????????
posts.bodyHtml: Okay so this is 100% an idea just incase anyone else likes it i thought i may aswell post . i have no idea how difficult or expensive it is to create a new server so i wont take offense if you say this is dumb.. My idea is that dream makes a prop hunt server because there are so many servers that nobody plays on which could be improved to something like prop hunt . Prop hunt has always been a game i liked and i wish it could be a dream server because im already started in this community 🙂 JUST AN IDEA BTW ----------- and sorry if u enjoy the servers i said nobody plays on , i also enjoy them just they never have people playing on them xD [herz2*] [dream*]

Hey @asapbasti,


Thanks for your suggestions. The problem is that the server will most likely stay empty for the whole time.
The ideas are infinite, so there's no problem in setting up another server but as I said it depens on the amount of players playing on it. It doesn't pay off when the server is staying empty all the time, it would just be a waste of resources.
We can still give it a try, like we did on the other projects. Maybe it'll pay off.


Best wishes, CyberTroniX
